articles.title: Prediction markets outlook for stocks in 2026 dims amid AI sell-off
articles.summary: The AI boom is finally hitting a reality check, and traders are repricing 2026 stock expectations downward as the sell-off gains momentum. This matters because prediction markets move faster than headlines, so if you're still holding bullish bets on mega-cap tech, you're probably already late to the pivot.

articles.title: 2028 Presidential Race Already Has $3 Million in Kalshi and Polymarket Bets
articles.summary: Folks are already dropping real money on 2028's presidential race across Kalshi and Polymarket, with $3M in total bets flying around despite the election being four years away. That's the kind of early liquidity that transforms these platforms from novelty betting sites into actual price-discovery mechanisms that serious political handicappers have to pay attention to.

articles.title: Kalshi pours money into California politics as its state, federal critics multiply
articles.summary: Kalshi, the regulated prediction market platform, is spending big on California politics while facing mounting scrutiny from both state and federal regulators. For bettors, this signals either confidence that Kalshi survives the regulatory gauntlet or desperation to influence the outcome before they don't.

articles.title: Inside Tribal Leaders’ Fight to Ban Kalshi
articles.summary: Tribal nations are pushing to block Kalshi from operating on their lands, citing gambling regulation concerns and sovereignty issues. If they succeed, it carves out a major regulatory wildcard that could inspire other jurisdictions to challenge the CFTC's prediction market framework.

articles.title: How the 2026 Midterms Played Out on Kalshi and Polymarket
articles.summary: The 2026 midterms proved predictive markets aren't just toys for political junkies anymore, with Kalshi and Polymarket generating serious trading volume and accurate forecasts months before election day. When political betting platforms outpace traditional polling, money managers and campaigns start paying attention, which means the next cycle will see even bigger stakes and deeper pockets flowing into these markets.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.summary: The Senate just passed a bill that would prohibit betting on wars and deaths in U.S. prediction markets, effectively nuking two of the most liquid contract categories. If it becomes law, it's the first real regulatory sledgehammer aimed at the entire prediction market ecosystem, and it signals Congress thinks some market activity is too morbid to allow.

articles.title: College Football Playoff Prediction Market on Kalshi: Wake Forest, Tennessee Surging
articles.summary: Two mid-tier college football programs are gaining real money on Kalshi's playoff odds, suggesting sharp bettors see something the casual crowd doesn't. If the prediction market is pricing these teams ahead of the broader betting market, there's either inefficiency to exploit or early signal that Vegas got it wrong.

articles.title: Kalshi argues its election predictions are a public service in bid to ward off regulators
articles.summary: Kalshi is pushing back against regulators by framing its election prediction market as a civic good rather than a gambling product. If that argument sticks, it could reshape how the entire prediction markets industry defends itself against the CFTC's skepticism.

articles.title: Coinbase backs CFTC proposal to distinguish prediction market contracts from gambling
articles.summary: Coinbase is throwing its weight behind a CFTC proposal that would legally separate prediction market contracts from gambling, clearing a regulatory path that's been muddier than a politician's tax returns. If this passes, prediction markets finally get their own lane instead of getting lumped in with slot machines, which means they can actually scale without regulators playing whack-a-mole with enforcement.

articles.title: Polymarket Indicates 29% Chance Anthropic’s Market Cap Lands Above $1.5 Trillion
articles.summary: Polymarket traders are pricing in a 29% shot that Anthropic's valuation cracks $1.5T, suggesting the AI powerhouse stays below that mark three times out of four. That gap between market consensus ($1.5T ceiling) and venture optimism (some rounds have implied higher) is exactly the kind of pricing inefficiency that makes prediction markets useful instead of just fun.

articles.title: Mamdani: Betting markets ‘degrade so much of life’
articles.summary: Mahmood Mamdani, a prominent public intellectual, is arguing that betting markets commodify and cheapen fundamental aspects of human experience. The critique matters because it's exactly the kind moral skepticism that could actually move regulators and shape how prediction markets get positioned as they expand into mainstream finance.

articles.title: Coinbase Eyes In-House Prediction Markets in First Half 2027
articles.summary: Coinbase is building its own prediction markets platform and plans to launch it in the first half of 2027, signaling that one of crypto's biggest players finally sees real money in betting on outcomes. If they execute, it fundamentally reshuffles the deck for platforms like Polymarket and PredictIt by bringing institutional liquidity and a retail userbase of millions into a space that's been dominated by scrappy startups.
